chunks: You will see the angels hovering around the Throne, glorifying their Lord with praise; and judgment will be rendered between them in truth, and it will be said: 'All praise is to Allah, Lord of the worlds.'
ai.seo_question: What is the role of angels around the Throne on the Day of Judgment according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Az-Zumar underscores the cosmic reality of the Hereafter, where the angels' continuous glorification (tasbih) serves as a backdrop to the final, irrevocable judgment (qada') between all creatures. It highlights the transition from the particular judgment of individuals to the universal acknowledgment of Allah’s sovereignty, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid in its eschatological context.
